overall.verdict: The desktop-dark variant of xln wallet demonstrates excellent fintech design with strong adherence to the premium dark theme, clear data visualization, and intuitive navigation. The visceral value principle is well-implemented through consistent bar charts, and trust is established through provable transaction details and clear state indicators. The layout effectively utilizes desktop width with appropriate information hierarchy.
priority_fixes: Increase text size for scale indicators and important explanations across all screens
Standardize amount display format and truncation rules
Improve prominence of transaction status indicators
Simplify technical explanations for non-technical users
Increase size and prominence of key trust elements like proof hashes and frame numbers
